learning_outcomes.text: Provide the student with a basic knowledge on the vibroacoustic topic, with particular reference to analysis and design of aerospace or car vehicle, or marine systems.
Comprehend noise generation and transmission in car vehicle and aircraft/spacecraft and marine systems, with allowance for fluid-structure interaction.
Study and apply analytical and numerical approaches on vibroacoustic case studies.
Be able to identify the most appropriate methods to analyze the vibroacoustic problem.
Be able to describe, in written form, in a clear and concise way and to explain orally with propriety of language the objectives, the procedure and the results of the elaborations carried out.
Be able to apply the acquired knowledge to contexts different from those presented during the course, and deepen the topics covered.

syllabus_topics: ORIGINS OF AIRCRAFT/AEROSPACE AND CAR VEHICLE NOISE
NOISE REFLECTION AND ABSORPTION, CAVITY RESONANT MODES
BOUNDARY ELEMENT METHOD (BEM): DIRECT AND INDIRECT FORMULATIONS
FINITE ELEMENT METHOD (FEM) AS APPLIED TO VIBROACOUSTIC ANALYSES
TECHNIQUES AIMED AT IMPROVING THE VIBROACOUSTIC COMFORT IN AIRCRAFT/AEROSPACE AND CAR VEHICLES
VISIT TO ITALIAN AEROSPACE RESEARCH CENTER (CIRA) LABORATORIES
VIBROACUSTIC ANALYSIS OF A CAR VEHICLE EXHAUST SYSTEM
TRASMISSION LOSS ASSESSMENT OF A CAR FIREWALL
ACOUSTIC SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS ON A CAR BODY
NOISE EFFECTS IN THE LIFT-OFF PHASE OF A SPACECRAFT LAUNCHER
assessment_rules: The fulfillment of the course objectives will be assessed by an oral examination. During the oral examination, students will answer questions on topics developed during the course and illustrate a previously developed technical project in a team, on a topic suggested by the teacher.
